STAGE 1 - teach an encoder what compression looks like
Explicit learning alone collapses the embedding
onto one number - and the same artifacts can come
from several quality factors, so it stops generalising.
Adding reconstruction keeps the representation rich.
QF=1 and QF=5, both unseen in training, separate
cleanly only under the dual objective.
